name: Safety & Hazard Alert Systems
description: Design systems that detect and alert against fire, gas leaks, smoke, and other hazardous conditions to protect life and property.

name: Environmental & Agricultural Monitoring
description: Monitor environmental parameters, crop conditions, water quality, and weather for smart farming and ecological awareness.

name: Motion, Robotics & Proximity Sensing
description: Build robots, gesture controllers, proximity alarms, and motion-based automation using kinematic and ultrasonic sensing.

name: Smart Sensing & Electrical Automation
description: Automate home and industrial systems using light, magnetic, touch, and wireless communication sensors.

name: Health & Human Interface Sensing
description: Create health monitoring gadgets and human-computer interfaces using bio-signal, pressure, and audio sensing technologies.

name: Student Innovation
description: No boundaries — combine any sensors across all categories to build a creative, original invention. Wild ideas welcome!
